note: Vendored generator inputs for the periodic table bundle. Every file under sources/ is byte-identical to the artifact named here; the generator verifies the digests before it reads a record. The parsed CIAAW and NIST files keep the upstream values verbatim and only restructure them, so the digests cover the restructured form. A derived extract names the upstream artifact and its digest in its own header, because the upstream file is too large to vendor; the digest in this table covers the extract.

pse-info.title: PSE-info element database
pse-info.redistribution: Vendored unchanged. The MIT licence requires the copyright notice and permission notice to travel with the data; both are reproduced in the attribution below.
pse-info.attribution: Element data from PSE-info, © 2023–2026 Paul Köhler, released under the MIT licence (https://pse-info.de/en/data).

pse-info-nuclides.title: PSE-info nuclide table, reduced to one nuclide per element
pse-info-nuclides.redistribution: Derived extract, not the upstream file: the upstream table is 5.6 MB and lists every nuclide, so only one record per element is shipped. An element counts as stable when the upstream table marks any of its nuclides stable; otherwise the record keeps the nuclide with the longest half-life together with its mass number and that half-life in seconds. The extract names the upstream artifact, its digest and its size in its own header. The MIT licence requires the copyright notice and permission notice to travel with the data; both are reproduced in the attribution below.
pse-info-nuclides.attribution: Nuclide data from PSE-info, © 2023–2026 Paul Köhler, released under the MIT licence (https://pse-info.de/en/data).

ciaaw.publisher: IUPAC Commission on Isotopic Abundances and Atomic Weights (CIAAW)
ciaaw.title: Standard Atomic Weights 2024
ciaaw.redistribution: The table is reproduced as factual data with source attribution. Only the numeric weights, their uncertainty digits and the published note codes are shipped; the surrounding prose is not.
ciaaw.attribution: Standard atomic weights from CIAAW, IUPAC (https://www.ciaaw.org/atomic-weights.htm), 2024 edition.

nist.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
nist.title: NIST Handbook of Basic Atomic Spectroscopic Data, ground-state configurations
nist.redistribution: Vendored as a verification input. Only the subshell occupation of the neutral ground state is shipped, and only after it agrees with the PSE-info configuration.
nist.attribution: Ground-state configurations cross-checked against the NIST Handbook of Basic Atomic Spectroscopic Data.
